hooks.command:
echo `# <#` >/dev/null
d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/app/src-tauri/target/debug"; for e in "$d/bop" "$d/bop.exe"; do if [ -n "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && [ -f "$e" ] && [ -x "$e" ]; then "$e" hook SessionStart >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0; fi; done; cat >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
#> > $null
$e = "$env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/app/src-tauri/target/debug/bop.exe"; if ($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $e -PathType Leaf)) { & $e hook SessionStart *> $null } else { $null = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() }; exit 0
